text: Rechecked the primary Hammers30 and LONI access pages. Hammers30 requires personal/institutional fields and academic non-commercial use; LONI atlas access requires accepting terms and a license. Asked the user asynchronously whether authorized LPBA40/Hammers30 data already exist locally, and for paths if available. No agreement was accepted, no form was submitted, and no fresh qualification outcomes were opened. This information request does not block ongoing D01/P02 work and does not establish either cohort as reserved, eligible or sufficiently independent.
